name: v30-45a-backdrop-stage
objective: v3.0 45 A on a real SillyTavern, no model: the animated backdrop mounts one canvas right after #bg1 (behind the chat), shows ST's current background as its base, and its layers follow story state: a `weather` quality moved rain -> snow switches the rain layer for the snow layer, and a beat whose effects.backdrop authors its own layers replaces the derived ones. The backdrop switch off removes the canvas from view and the flag from <html>; on brings it back.

steps.eval: const started = Date.now(); while (!globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop?.view().active && Date.now() - started < 15000) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); const view = globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop?.view(); if (!view?.active) throw new Error(`the backdrop never became active: ${JSON.stringify(view ?? null)}`); const root = document.getElementById('so-backdrop-root'); if (!root || root.previousElementSibling?.id !== 'bg1') throw new Error('the backdrop root must sit right after #bg1'); const style = getComputedStyle(root); if (style.position !== 'fixed' || style.zIndex !== '-1' || style.pointerEvents !== 'none') throw new Error(`root must be a fixed, click-through layer behind the chat: ${style.position} ${style.zIndex} ${style.pointerEvents}`); if (!document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-so-backdrop')) throw new Error('html[data-so-backdrop] missing while active'); const canvas = document.getElementById('so-backdrop-canvas'); return { base: view.base, layers: view.layers, canvas: { width: canvas?.width, height: canvas?.height, opacity: canvas?.style.opacity } };

import_story.title: SO-V30-45a Backdrop
import_story.description: Weather moves; the second beat authors its own backdrop.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!(await rt.setQuality('weather', 'rain'))) throw new Error('setQuality weather=rain refused'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const view = globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop.view(); if (!view.layers.includes('rain') || view.state?.weather !== 'rain') throw new Error(`rain weather must show the rain layer: ${JSON.stringify(view)}`); return { layers: view.layers, state: view.state };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.setQuality('weather', 'snow'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const view = globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop.view(); if (!view.layers.includes('snow') || view.layers.includes('rain')) throw new Error(`snow must replace rain: ${JSON.stringify(view.layers)}`); return { layers: view.layers, running: view.running };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.activateCheckpoint('cellar'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)); const view = globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop.view(); if (JSON.stringify(view.layers) !== JSON.stringify(['dust', 'flicker'])) throw new Error(`the authored cellar layers must replace the derived ones: ${JSON.stringify(view.layers)}`); if (view.state?.indoor !== true || view.state?.timeOfDay !== 'night') throw new Error(`authored indoor/time must win: ${JSON.stringify(view.state)}`); return { layers: view.layers, state: view.state };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms = 8000) => { const start = Date.now(); while (!test() && Date.now() - start < ms) await wait(150); return test(); }; document.querySelector('#so-open-workspace')?.click(); if (!(await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display')))) throw new Error('the workspace did not open'); if (!(await until(() => { document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator')?.click(); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display')?.click(); return document.querySelector('#so-backdrop-enabled'); }, 15000))) throw new Error('#so-backdrop-enabled is not on the Display page'); const toggle = document.querySelector('#so-backdrop-enabled'); if (toggle.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') throw new Error('the backdrop switch must start on'); toggle.click(); await wait(700); const off = { checked: document.querySelector('#so-backdrop-enabled')?.getAttribute('aria-checked'), active: globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop.view().active, flag: document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-so-backdrop'), opacity: document.getElementById('so-backdrop-canvas')?.style.opacity, stored: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().display.backdrop.enabled }; document.querySelector('#so-backdrop-enabled')?.click(); await until(() => globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop.view().active, 5000); const on = { checked: document.querySelector('#so-backdrop-enabled')?.getAttribute('aria-checked'), active: globalThis.storyOrchestratorBackdrop.view().active, flag: document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-so-backdrop'), stored: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().display.backdrop.enabled }; document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal')?.close?.(); if (off.active || off.flag || off.opacity !== '0' || off.stored !== false) throw new Error(`switch off must hide the backdrop: ${JSON.stringify(off)}`); if (!on.active || !on.flag || on.stored !== true) throw new Error(`switch on must bring it back: ${JSON.stringify(on)}`); return { off, on };
